Produces: Infinite lifegain; Infinite lifegain triggers; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite landfall triggers; Return all nonland permanents from your graveyard to the battlefield
Start: Emeria Shepherd (battlefield); Aftermath Analyst (battlefield); Overgrown Estate (battlefield); The Wandering Minstrel (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
  You control a Plains.
Steps: Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
  Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
  Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
  Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
  When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
  Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
  Repeat.
Notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents.   When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
  Resolve the Evereth ability.
  Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sin.
  When Sin dies, it triggers twice.
  Resolve the first trigger, returning Sin from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As Sin enters, remove the -1/-1 counter from the creature sacrificed in step 1, causing Sin to enter with a +1/+1 counter on it instead.
  Resolve the second Sin trigger, putting the counters it had on it when it was sacrificed onto a creature you control and failing to shuffle it into your library as it's no longer in your graveyard.
  Resolve the Evereth ability from step 4.
  Repeat.

## Combo 7253-7254-7255
Cards: Mass of Mysteries + Prismabasher + Twinflame Travelers
Color identity: WUBRG | Bracket: 3-4+ (Spicy) | Popularity: 1200 | Commander: legal
Produces: Near-infinite combat damage
Start: Mass of Mysteries (battlefield); Prismabasher (battlefield: without summoning sickness); Twinflame Travelers (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You have two or more opponents.
Steps: At the beginning of your combat phase, Mass of Mysteries triggers twice due to Twinflame Travelers, giving Prismabasher myriad twice.
  Declare Mass of Mysteries (if able) and Prismabasher as attackers, attacking the same opponent.
  Prismabasher's myriad ability triggers four times due to Twinflame Travelers.
  Resolve a myriad trigger, creating a token copy of Prismabasher attacking each other opponent.
  When the Prismabasher token(s) enter, they each trigger.
  Resolve the first trigger, giving five creature you control +5/+5 until end of turn.
  Repeat step 6 for any remaining trigger.
  Repeat step 4 for the remaining myriad triggers.
Notes: If your commander is attacking, you can boost its power to 21 or higher, which will deal lethal commander damage to an opponent. It isn't required for opponents to not block your creatures, as all the Prismabashers have trample, but it is recommended when possible. When distributing the stat increases, make sure to give the creatures attacking each opponent just enough to deal lethal damage (if able) to maximize the effect. The amount of damage dealt will scale the more opponents you have.
